messages:
Alex W: morning! quick idea — who'd be into a "trail sprint + boulder" challenge next week? basically run ~3 miles out to the crag, do a 20-min boulder session, run back. time and style points. :mountain: :dash:
Samir K: 100% yes. love the hybrid. morning or evening?
Maria T: morning for me. adds to my commute? :sweat_smile:
Kev D: count me in. what's the distance? i'm on a folding bike option if it's too far.
Alex W: plan: 3 miles each way, maybe make one weekday sunrise 6:30am and a weekend longer route. proposed rules: 1) run there, no driving 2) 20 min bouldering limit 3) optional weighted vest for glory :laughing:
Jen L: I can bring crash pads? doubt it, but i can take photos. :camera_flash:
FitBot: auto-log: created "Trail+Boulder - Week of Apr 5" -> RSVP with :thumbsup: in thread.
Samir K: poll: morning weekday or saturday? react with :sunrise: for weekday, :sunglasses: for sat.
Maria T: :sunrise:
Kev D: :sunglasses:
Alex W: ok weekday it is. who can do Tue or Thu?
Samir K: Tue works.
Jen L: Thu better for me but can try Tue once.
Maria T: I'll do Tue. can we do shoes advice? which shoes for mixing road to crag then bouldering?
Kev D: trail shoes with sticky rubber if possible. or carry flats in bag. I usually run in Salomons then change into flats for the rock.
Alex W: I'll make a shorthand checklist: "trail shoes + chalk + pad + water + quick-change socks" — maybe post as a thread pinned.
FitBot: reminder set for Tue 6:15am at south gate. good luck! :rocket:
Samir K: stoked. also bets? loser buys coffee at office. :coffee:
Jen L: done. see you early, please tell me there's coffee. :pray:
